title: Protocol for analyzing root halotropism using split-agar system in Arabidopsis thaliana
protocol: Sterilize the seeds with 5% (v/v) sodium hypochlorite for 10 min in a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
Rinse seeds with sterile water for 5 times.
Resuspend the seeds with 0.05% agarose.
Prepare 1/2 MS medium (1.2% agar, 1% sucrose, pH 5.7) with a magnetic bar in a 1 L bottle and autoclave at 120°C for 20 min.
Cool the medium on a magnetic stirrer to about 45°C.
Pour autoclaved medium into 10 cm × 10 cm square disposable Petri dishes (about 40 mL/plate).
Dot the seeds on the plate with a 1 mL pipette.
Seal plates with micropore tape (3M).
Wrap the plate with aluminum foil and stratify the seeds at 4°C for 3 days.
Grow seedlings vertically in an incubator at 21°C–23°C under a 16-h light, 8-h dark photoperiod for 4-5 days.
Prepare 1/2 MS medium with 1.2% agar, 1% sucrose, and pH 5.7.
Autoclave the prepared 1/2 MS medium at 120°C for 20 minutes.
Cool down the 1/2 MS medium containing 200 mM NaCl to 45°C using a magnetic stirrer.
Keep the cooled 1/2 MS medium in a 65°C incubator.
Place a handmade plastic separator along the diagonal of a 10 cm × 10 cm square Petri dish.
Sterilize the plastic separator with 75% alcohol for 10 minutes before use.
Seal the junction between the plastic separator and the Petri dish using a pipette.
Pour the 1/2 MS medium containing 200 mM NaCl into one side of the Petri dish.
Wait until the poured medium solidifies in the Petri dish.
Remove the plastic separator from the Petri dish.
Pour 1/2 MS medium into the empty side of the Petri dish.
Pour the 1/2 MS medium containing 200 mM NaCl into the sealed half Petri dish.
Wait 20 minutes for the medium to solidify and remove the plastic separator.
Directly pour the 1/2 MS medium kept at 65°C into the empty half of the Petri dish.
Allow the medium to solidify (approximately 15 minutes).
Dry the medium for 30–45 minutes without covering it.
Prepare 1/2 MS medium with 1.2% agar and 1% sucrose, adjust pH to 5.7.
Autoclave the prepared medium at 120°C for 20 minutes.
Add 200 mM NaCl to another portion of 1/2 MS medium and prepare it similarly.
Place the 1/2 MS medium with 200 mM NaCl on a magnetic stirrer until cooled to 45°C.
Pour the 1/2 MS medium (with or without 200 mM NaCl) into a square disposable Petri dish.
Wait for 20 minutes until the poured medium solidifies.
Cut the solidified medium diagonally with a blade.
Press the half-medium inward along the interface between the medium and the Petri dish using the blade.
Remove one half of the medium by pressing it out along the cut line.
Pour fresh 1/2 MS medium into the empty side of the Petri dish.
Maintain the temperature consistency for different batches of 1/2 MS medium during preparation.
Solidify the 1/2 MS medium at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Dry the solidified medium without cover for 30-45 minutes.
Draw a straight line on the 1/2 MS medium side 0.3 cm parallel to the interface between the two media using a marker pen.
Draw a reference line for root tips on the back of the Petri dish with a marker pen.
Keep the root tips along the gravity direction and contact the black line.
Transfer 4–5 day-old vertically grown seedlings from 1/2 MS medium to split-agar plates.
Transfer 10–12 seedlings to a Petri dish, maintaining an interval of 0.5–0.75 cm between each seedling.
Add exogenous reagents to 1/2 MS medium to test their effects on halotropic response.
Transfer 4–5 day-old vertically growing seedlings to a split-agar plate with halostimulation for 3 hours.
Rinse the treated seedlings three times in sterilized water quickly (about 1 second each).
Stain the seedlings with 20 μM CoroNa Green for 1 hour.
Rinse the stained seedlings three times in sterilized water quickly (about 1 second each).
Analyze and image the stained root tips using a confocal microscope.
Prepare 20 cm × 20 cm square Petri dishes with 1/2 MS, 1% sucrose and 1.2% agar.
Sterilize YFP-NPSN12 homozygous seeds with 5% sodium hypochlorite for 10 minutes in a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
Rinse seeds in sterile MilliQ water five times.
Sow seeds on 1/2 MS medium in a square Petri dish with 0.5 cm intervals.
Seal the square Petri dish with micropore tape.
Stratify the seeds at 4°C for 2 days in the dark.
Grow seedlings vertically in an incubator at 23°C for 4 days (16-h light/8-h dark photoperiod).
Pour 1/2 MS medium into a chambered cover slide.
Install a 20× objective onto the objective inverter.
Transfer a 4-day-old seedling with straight root onto the split-agar medium in the chambered cover slide.
Cover the seedling with a cover slide and seal it with micropore tape.
Place the chambered cover slide vertically on the vertical stage.
Adjust for a clear view of the epidermal cells in the root tip.
Start imaging with Z-steps of 0.5 μm intervals covering a depth of more than 10 μm from the root surface to the interior.
Capture images at 10 min time intervals for 3 h.
Open Fiji software and ensure it is updated with TrackMate 7.
Open the images in Fiji software.
Extract images with clear epidermal cell boundaries at every time point.
Compose extracted images into a stack (32-bit images).
Find Tracking>>TrackMate in the plugins pulldown list.
Open TrackMate 7 in a new window.
Select MorphoLibJ detector and proceed to next step.
Check “Simplify contours”, then select preview.
Adjust settings to outline most of the cells, and proceed.
Set filters on spots as area, check "Below" for cell coverage only.
Select Overlap tracker for tracking.
Edit display options to set preferred appearance, including spot alpha transparency to 1.
At "Select an action", choose Capture overlay and execute to export segmented images.
Sterilize homozygous transgenic seeds with 5% sodium hypochlorite for 10 min in a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
Rinse sterilized seeds five times in sterile MilliQ water.
Sow seeds on the right side of 1/2 MS in chambered cover slides (ibidi, 80287) with 0.3 cm intervals and push them into the medium until they are close to the bottom cover slide.
Seal chambered cover slides with micropore tape.
Stratify seeds at 4°C for 2 days in the dark.
Grow seedlings vertically in an incubator at 23°C for 4 days under a 16-h light/8-h dark photoperiod.
Replace the left corner of the 1/2 MS medium with 1/2 MS medium containing 200 mM NaCl for halo-stimulation treatment.
Install the 100× objective (Apo TIRF, NA 1.49) onto the objective inverter (LSM TECH).
Place a chambered cover slide vertically on the vertical stage.
Adjust to get a clear view of the epidermal cells in the root elongation zone.
Start imaging with a 0.5 μm interval and 20 μm distance Z-step at a 30 min time interval for 2 h.
Detect GFP signals with a 488-nm laser and a 482/35-nm emission filter.
Detect mCherry signals with a 561-nm laser and a 542/27-nm emission filter.
